attBesluta.text: I was able to construct this on my own. There are a lot of screws but it is secure once you put them all in. I filled the bottom with branches and put compost on top. I have used it for several months and successfully grown courgettes, squashed and beans. It is a very good size and has allowed me to grow veggies more easily.

This was way better quality than I expected. I cut it in a smaller more custom sheets with my metal bandsaw. Then I use this to wrap the insulation I put on top of my boiler pipes. This stuff was so high quality, hard to rip, and was so perfect that I couldn't have loved it any better. My boiler pipes now stay cooler since I have this wrapped on it.

Item came in a small manageable package. Value for money. Easy to assemble and all tools, including gloves, supplied. I recommend this product for an economic, easy to assemble product. Item also comes in colours.
